cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(map_simulation LANGUAGES CXX)
include(CTest)
add_library(map-simulation-base INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(map-simulation-base INTERFACE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
target_compile_features(map-simulation-base INTERFACE cxx_std_17)
add_library(map-simulation STATIC src/regions.cpp src/contours.cpp src/local_route.cpp src/placement.cpp src/region_route.cpp src/definitions.cpp src/creep.cpp src/world.cpp src/production.cpp src/harvest.cpp src/projectile.cpp src/combat.cpp src/auxiliary.cpp src/replay.cpp src/replay_commands.cpp src/replay_identity.cpp src/replay_selection.cpp src/scenario.cpp)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
target_link_libraries(map-simulation PUBLIC map-simulation-base Threads::Threads)
target_compile_features(map-simulation PUBLIC cxx_std_20)

if(BUILD_TESTING)
add_executable(map-simulation-scenario-tests tests/scenario_tests.cpp)
target_link_libraries(map-simulation-scenario-tests PRIVATE map-simulation)
add_test(NAME map-simulation-scenario COMMAND map-simulation-scenario-tests)

add_executable(map-replay-tests tests/replay_tests.cpp tests/replay_command_tests.cpp tests/replay_selection_tests.cpp)
target_link_libraries(map-replay-tests PRIVATE map-simulation)
add_test(NAME map-replay COMMAND map-replay-tests)

add_executable(map-dat-tests tests/dat_tests.cpp)
target_link_libraries(map-dat-tests PRIVATE map-simulation)
add_test(NAME map-dat COMMAND map-dat-tests)
add_executable(map-iscript-tests tests/iscript_tests.cpp)
target_link_libraries(map-iscript-tests PRIVATE map-simulation)
add_test(NAME map-iscript COMMAND map-iscript-tests)
add_executable(map-geometry-tests tests/geometry_tests.cpp)
target_link_libraries(map-geometry-tests PRIVATE map-simulation-base)
add_test(NAME map-geometry COMMAND map-geometry-tests)
add_executable(map-motion-tests tests/motion_tests.cpp)
target_link_libraries(map-motion-tests PRIVATE map-simulation)
add_test(NAME map-motion COMMAND map-motion-tests)
add_executable(map-air-tests tests/air_tests.cpp)
target_link_libraries(map-air-tests PRIVATE map-simulation)
add_test(NAME map-air COMMAND map-air-tests)
add_executable(map-region-tests tests/region_tests.cpp)
target_link_libraries(map-region-tests PRIVATE map-simulation)
add_test(NAME map-regions COMMAND map-region-tests)
add_executable(map-contour-tests tests/contour_tests.cpp)
target_link_libraries(map-contour-tests PRIVATE map-simulation)
add_test(NAME map-contours COMMAND map-contour-tests)
add_executable(map-local-route-tests tests/local_route_tests.cpp)
target_link_libraries(map-local-route-tests PRIVATE map-simulation)
add_test(NAME map-local-route COMMAND map-local-route-tests)
add_executable(map-placement-tests tests/placement_tests.cpp)
target_link_libraries(map-placement-tests PRIVATE map-simulation)
add_test(NAME map-placement COMMAND map-placement-tests)
add_executable(map-definition-tests tests/definition_tests.cpp)
target_link_libraries(map-definition-tests PRIVATE map-simulation)
add_test(NAME map-definitions COMMAND map-definition-tests)
add_executable(map-creep-tests tests/creep_tests.cpp)
target_link_libraries(map-creep-tests PRIVATE map-simulation)
add_test(NAME map-creep COMMAND map-creep-tests)
add_executable(map-world-tests tests/world_tests.cpp tests/economy_tests.cpp tests/production_tests.cpp)
target_link_libraries(map-world-tests PRIVATE map-simulation)
if(MSVC)
  # This fixture keeps many independent value snapshots in one call frame.
  target_link_options(map-world-tests PRIVATE /STACK:8388608)
endif()
add_test(NAME map-world COMMAND map-world-tests)
add_executable(map-search-tests tests/search_tests.cpp)
target_link_libraries(map-search-tests PRIVATE map-simulation)
add_test(NAME map-search COMMAND map-search-tests)
set_tests_properties(map-search PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 20)

endif()
